metrics.profile_summary: Senior Brand Manager with over 14 years of experience in luxury beauty, skincare, and cosmetics. Expert in executing 360° integrated marketing campaigns and managing multi-million dollar budgets to drive double-digit sales growth.

education.institution: Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology (SZABIST)

experience.description: Managed $1M A&P budget and led 360° campaigns for luxury brands, achieving 35% annual growth and launching Pakistan's first Dolce & Gabbana Beauty Boutique.
Executed nationwide in-store activations and digital campaigns, monitoring market trends and KPIs to optimize performance and increase gross sales.
Designed trade promotions and merchandising strategies for luxury cosmetics and fast food franchises, increasing sell-out by 55%.
Managed brand performance for Bourjois Makeup across 45 outlets and delivered sales training for 70 beauty advisors.
Managed media buying and ATL/BTL activities for Dawlance and Olivia Makeup, achieving 27% sales growth.
Executed print media campaigns with budgets over PKR 7M for consumer brands including Caresse and Nurpur.

strengths: Proven track record of driving significant sales growth
Expertise in 360° campaign management and agency coordination
weaknesses: Significantly overqualified for a tactical specialist role
No explicit mention of Canva or Meta Business Suite
evaluation.summary: The candidate is a highly seasoned marketing leader who far exceeds the requirements of a Marketing Specialist. While they possess all the necessary skills to execute the tasks, their seniority level suggests they may be overqualified for this specific role.
